dct_description_sm: A layer of the Protected Major Transit Station Area within Durham Region, which are a part of the Strategic Growth Areas within the Durham Region Official Plan. Strategic Growth Areas in Durham include Urban Growth Centres, Regional Centres, Protected Major Transit Station Areas and Rapid Transit Corridors. ROP Consolidation September 3, 2024.
